title: Each change names its team and operator: a team field, the KB-Teams trailer, team-scoped coord
goal: A root's _root.md or pointer names its owning team, which check.py validates and kbroot.py list and kb_status show; the commit hook adds a computed KB-Teams trailer for the roots a commit changes and check-trailers accepts it; coord.py serve reads key files as <keys>/<team>/<operator>, stamps events and claim holders with <team>/<operator> and refuses a caller's write under another team's team/<name>/ keys; plugin.md says which identity a person, a headless runner and a fetch root use

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
